Field.name: InputImageFile
Field.manpage: Input file with images containing features to average. If this option is not entered, the first non-option argument will be used for this input file.

Field.name: PointModelFile
Field.usage: Name of model file with points to be averaged
Field.manpage: Name of model file with points to be averaged. If this option is not entered, the second non-option argument will be used for this input file.

Field.name: OutputFile
Field.manpage: Output file for average image. If this option is not entered, the third non-option argument will be used for this output file.

Field.name: PieceListFile
Field.usage: Name of piece list file if image is montaged or out of sequence

Field.name: ObjectsToAverage
Field.usage: List of objects with points to average
Field.manpage: List of objects with points to average (comma-separated ranges allowed). The default is to take all points from all open contour or scattered point objects. This option can be used to select a subset of objects in the model or force the use of a closed contour object.

Field.name: BoxSizeXandY
Field.usage: Size of box to average in X and Y

Field.name: ModeOfOutput
Field.usage: Mode for output (default is same as input)
Field.manpage: Mode for output: 0 for byte, 1 for integer, 2 for 32-bit float, 6 for unsigned integer, or 12 for 16-bit float. The default is the same as that of the input, although the default mode of floating point output for MRC files is governed by the value of environment variable IMOD_WRITE_FLOATS_16BIT. Mode 12 is allowed only if the output format is MRC.

Field.name: PassesThroughData
Field.usage: Number of passes (1 or 2, default is 2 to align to first average)
Field.manpage: Number of passes through the data, either 1 or 2. On the second pass, the boxes will be aligned to the average from the first pass. The default is 2; enter 1 to skip the alignment pass.

Field.name: LinearInterpolation
Field.usage: Use linear instead of cubic interpolation when extracting box

SectionHeader.name: ObsoleteOptions
SectionHeader.manpage: OBSOLETE OPTIONS ^ These options are not needed when Xcorrstack(1) is used to correlate ^ an average with images.

Field.name: SizeOfOutputXandY
Field.usage: Size of output file in X and Y (default is same size as box)

Field.name: FillValue
Field.usage: Value to fill with when output array is bigger than box
Field.manpage: Value to fill with when output array is bigger than box. The default is the mean along the edge of the average image. This entry is ignored if the output is the same size as the box.

Field.name: SplitIntoCorners
Field.usage: Split average into the four corners of the output array

Field.name: ZeroMean
Field.usage: Shift the output to have a zero mean value
Field.manpage: Shift the output to have a zero mean value. This option is ignored if the data mode of the output is bytes or unsigned integers.

Field.name: ParameterFile
Field.manpage: Read parameter entries as keyword-value pairs from a parameter file.
